caseNameFull: Inland Waterways Corp. v. Hardee, Receiver

opinions.text: Certiorari, 306 U. S. 626, to the Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia. The motion for shbstitution is granted and Frederick J. Young, Receiver of the Commercial National Bank of Washington, ,D. C., is substituted as the party respondent in the place and stead of Cary H. Hardee, resigned.
